{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Compute conversion rates for each channel
total_emails = df[df['channel'] == 'email']['converted'].count()
converted_emails = df[df['channel'] == 'email']['converted'].sum()
conversion_rate_email = converted_emails / total_emails



total_paid_search = df[df['channel'] == 'paid_search']['converted'].count()
converted_paid_search = df[df['channel'] == 'paid_search']['converted'].sum()
conversion_rate_paid_search = converted_paid_search / total_paid_search

# Compute the difference in conversion rates
difference = conversion_rate_email - conversion_rate_paid_search

# Print results
print(f"Conversion rate (email): {conversion_rate_email:.4f}")
print(f"Conversion rate (paid_search): {conversion_rate_paid_search:.4f}")
print(f"Difference (email - paid_search): {difference:.4f}")"}
